method: Normal spawn and real keyboard/mouse/pointer capture; one explicitly labeled contextmenu-only fallback injection.
checks: Free cursor clicking empty sky does not select the planet under the central reticle
Right-clicking a planet label selects once, without requiring mouse capture
Free cursor right-click uses the actual planet pixel, beyond its HUD label
A contextmenu-only platform event can lock a visible planet
Captured real right-click locks the reticle candidate once and immediately updates the panel
Captured Control-click secondary gesture locks the reticle target
V locks the reticle target and reconfirming the same planet gives explicit feedback
Looking away gives a miss message and preserves the selected destination
Paused keyboard input cannot change the navigation target
Captured mouse on a landed ship explains Space takeoff instead of silently ignoring lock
